Aisha (CEO): Thanks everyone — quick live Q: how should teams think about prioritizing Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private over the next 18 months?
Jon (VP Product): Short answer: customer needs drive it. Hosted for PLG velocity, Dedicated for predictable enterprise scale, Private for regulated customers.
Ravi (Eng): Curious about cost tradeoffs — do we expect Dedicated unit costs to approach Hosted w/ larger commits?
Aisha (CEO): Good call — Dedicated will be meaningfully cheaper per-token at scale (committed pools + autoscaling) but Hosted has faster time-to-value. Encourage teams to measure latency SLOs + data sensitivity first.
Lena (Growth): For GTM, should AE motion push Dedicated or seed Private conversations early?
Jon (VP Product): AEs should qualify on compliance needs early. If security/regulatory box is checked, route to Private; otherwise demo Hosted and trial Dedicated for predictability.
Marcel (Research): From model roadmap perspective, are we prioritizing more quantization/compilation features or multi-model routing optimizations?
Aisha (CEO): Both, but sequence matters: compilers/quantization unlock cost wins for most customers — prioritize that. Multi-model routing is next-level reliability/cost optimization for large customers.
Ravi (Eng): Any new SLOs or observability priorities product teams should bake into roadmaps?
Jon (VP Product): Yes — include token-level cost attribution and per-route latency p95 as first-class SLOs. Console changes to expose those metrics are on the roadmap.
Lena (Growth): Competitors are pushing turnkey hosted models with low friction. What's our positioning soundbite for sales?
Aisha (CEO): "We make inference predictable and economical across any environment." Emphasize unified API + rollouts + cost controls — not just model access.
Ravi (Eng): If traffic spikes and we fall back to smaller quantized variants, how transparent will that be to customers?
Jon (VP Product): We’ll expose fallbacks in the console and via request headers. Teams can opt into automatic fallback policies or keep strict version pinning.
Marcel (Research): For partner models (open weights), any guidance on vetting for production quality?
Aisha (CEO): Require perf profiles (latency/cost/quality) and eval suites before promoting to catalog. Research will publish a checklist.
Eve-bot: Recording and slides from today's all-hands are posted: https://redwood.slides/all-hands/mar-2026 (recording: 2h).
Lena (Growth): One last ask from me — can we get a short one-pager for AE playbook that maps customer signals to recommended offering?
Jon (VP Product): On it. Will draft and share in #product by end of week.
Ravi (Eng): Thanks — helps with prioritizing infra work.
Aisha (CEO): Appreciate the questions. If anyone has follow-ups DM me or drop in #product. :thumbsup:
